 Follow December Social Security payment schedule: Get ready for changes, early COLA for some
 Leada Gore Mon, November 16, 2026 at 8:49 PM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. December's Social Security payment schedule includes a change and an early cost of living raise for some beneficiaries.
 Traditional Social Security will be paid on standard dates in December:
 People born between 1 st and 10 th are paid on the second Wednesday (Dec. 9)
 People born between 11 th and 20 th are paid on third Wednesday (Dec. 16)
 People born between 21 st and 31 st are paid on the fourth Wednesday (Dec. 23)
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The changes for the month come for those who receive Supplemental Security Income (SSI). SSI is paid on the first of each month — Tuesday, Dec. 1 this year. However, the Jan. 1, 2027, payment date will hit bank accounts a day early – Thursday, Dec. 31 – because the regular payment date is a federal holiday.
 The Social Security Administration moves payment dates when they fall on a weekend or holiday.
 People who receive both Social Security and SSI – as well as those who began receiving Social Security before May 1997 – are paid on a separate schedule. Those people receive SSI on the first (or Dec. 31 in 2026) and then on the third Wednesday (Dec. 23).
 Early COLA
 Social Security and SSI benefits will increase 3.6% in 2027. Social Security's COLA will go into effect with the first January payment, but SSI recipients will see the change Dec. 31.
 Advertisement Advertisement The average retired worker will see benefits increase $75 a month, or $900 a year, from an average of $2,095 to $2,170.
 More than 56 million retirees, dependents and disabled workers receive Social Security benefits.
 Average SSI benefits will increase:
 Individual - $1,029 per month, up $35 from 2026
 Couples - $1,544 per month, up $53 from 2026
 Essential persons - $516 a month, up $18 from 2026
 More than 7 million people in the U.S. receive benefits through SSI. Payments average about $740 a month and go to low-income senior citizens, people with disabilities and people who are blind.
